conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Nathan from Amazon Security Operations. Am I speaking with Mrs. Chen?
Yes, this is Chen. How I can help?

Thank you for confirming. We detected abnormal activity on your Amazon account this morning. Before we proceed, I want to assure you that your information is safe with us, and we are here to resolve this together.
I not understand. What activity happen? I use Amazon last week only.
No worries, Mrs. Chen. According to our records, someone attempted to order a $1,200 laptop from your account, shipping to Texas. Did you make this purchase?
No, never. I don't know anyone in Texas.

That's exactly why we flagged the order. To protect your account, we need to verify your identity and process a refund for the unauthorized transaction. May I please confirm the email address linked to your Amazon account?
My email is chen.li888@gmail.com
Perfect, thank you. For your protection, I need to complete a secure verification. Do you have access to a computer or smartphone at this moment?
Yes, I on my phone now. Computer very slow.

That's absolutely fine. We can continue using your phone. For the refund process, Amazon requires you to confirm your identity through a secure form. I will guide you step by step so there is no confusion.
Okay, but my English not so good. Please talk slow.
Of course, I will speak very clearly. Please open your browser and go to www.amzn-verification.com. This is our secure Amazon verification portal.
Wait, www...amzn...Can you spell again?
Certainly. A-M-Z-N-dash-verification-dot-com. Let me know when the page loads.
Yes... I see page ask for code.
Great. I am generating your one-time security code now. It is 485219. Please enter that on the page.
I enter, now loading.
Excellent. Now, you should see a form asking for your full name and billing address. Please fill that in so we can start the refund.
I put my name and address. I hope this stop problem.

You're doing great, Mrs. Chen. To complete the process, Amazon's policy requires a verification deposit. This is a temporary hold and will be refunded to you immediately after identity confirmation. I know this process can be confusing, but if we don't complete it, your account may remain at risk or be frozen.
I don't understand deposit. Why I pay? I not buy anything.

I completely understand your concern. Amazon has strict procedures for fraud prevention. The deposit is only for verification. If you skip this step, unfortunately, I may be forced to escalate your case, which could lead to a temporary ban on your account and loss of access to your orders. This is standard and nothing to worry about; I promise you will get the money back.
Oh no, I need Amazon for shopping. How much deposit?

The verification deposit is $300. You can complete this securely by purchasing Amazon gift cards. Once you provide the codes, your account will be unlocked, and the refund, including the $300, will be processed immediately.
I need go buy gift card? Can you not just take from my card?

Unfortunately, due to security regulations, we cannot charge your card directly. Using gift cards is the fastest, most secure method. If you need instructions, I can guide you to the nearest store that sells Amazon gift cards.
Okay, I can go store now. But I not sure how to do after.

No worries. After you purchase the gift cards, simply scratch off the back and read me the codes. I will enter them into our secure portal. Remember, this is just for verification and you will see the amount refunded to your Amazon balance within 20 minutes.
I try to go now. It take maybe 20 minute.
Take your time, Mrs. Chen. I'll stay on the line to help you. Please keep your phone with you, and let me know as soon as you have the cards.
Okay, I get cards. I have three, $100 each.
Perfect. Please read me the codes one by one so I can verify your account.
First code is 3X4Q-7H8L-9P2S... Second is 5W2M-1Z6F-8S3K... Third is 7N2V-6J9L-4Q5C.
Thank you, I am entering them now. Please hold for a moment while the system processes your verification.
Okay, I wait. You promise I get refund?

Absolutely. I want you to know we always support our customers. However, if we don't complete this verification, your account may remain locked, and it could affect your ability to shop or receive packages. I really don't want to lose my job over this, so I appreciate your cooperation.
I just want problem fix. I do everything you say.
You've been very helpful. The final step is confirming your bank for the refund transfer. May I have the name of your bank and last four digits of the account number?
Bank is First National, last four is 7832.
Thank you, Mrs. Chen. You should see the refund in your Amazon balance within 20 minutes. If there are any issues, I will call you back. Have a good day, and thank you for your trust.
